body: parallel scheduling combines global quota, channel quota, and latency budget. checkpoint resume is deterministic; citation attribution remains stable after recovery. 并行 预算 检查点 恢复。
title: Parallel budget checkpoint

body: Evidence is reranked by retrieval score, query coverage, and fragment length fit. MMR overlap removal records discarded fragments. Every retained evidence fragment must have a citation doc_id; the local answer template prints citation attribution for all evidence. 引用 证据 拼接。
title: 引用归属与证据拼接 Citation Coverage

body: Latency budgets are measured from actual stage completion time, never by sleeping or declaring a thread timeout. Budget overruns return E_LATENCY_BUDGET with elapsed time and accepted subquery count. 超预算 显式 降级。
title: Latency budgets and explicit degradation

body: 查询先做 Unicode NFKC、空白折叠与全半角统一，再按中文单字和拉丁连续串切分。分解规则与本地同义词表生成带优先级的子查询。query normalization uses deterministic tokenization.
title: 查询规范化与同义词
